cost_estimate_seconds.basis: four-rank agent-driver 128^2 t=1.2 validation 22.58s and 256^2 t=1.2 pilot 173.37s; cubic-in-N, linear-in-t sensitivity estimate
cost_estimate_seconds.limitations: Observed scaling was derived at eta=0.001 only; other eta may change timestep count and crossing time. Refinement is limited prospectively to S_eta=250, 1000, and 4000, the minimum three-point fit spanning the nominal interval; n=3 gives a wide confidence interval. Each refined mesh is 1.25x its matched base mesh and adds at least one cell across nominal delta_SP. Forecast excludes reviewer latency and analysis overhead; retain at least 180 seconds for independent review. Missing flux windows are censored. Current budget does not cover full predicted base+refinement matrix plus 180 s final review and review/analysis overhead. After production approval, run low/high base endpoints first, update cost from realized steps/window crossings, then continue distinct base cases only if analysis and review reserve remain; defer all refinement unless a fresh measured forecast fits.

resolution_policy: initial sheet requires >=4 cells (N/alpha), nominal Sweet-Parker width requires >=4 cells, and measured central-current FWHM requires >=4 cells during the flux window; matched refinement uses 1.25x N and adds >=1 nominal-width cell (about 5 versus 4 at S_eta=1000/4000). S_eta=250 base uses N=96 to satisfy N/alpha>=4. Failures remain ineligible.
decision: Require all four finite positive rates from Bx/By paths at 0.05 and decimated 0.10 cadence. Fit eligible families by OLS(log normalized R, log nominal S_eta), two-sided 95% Student-t intervals (n-2 df); enumerate all 2^n mixed per-case low/high rate-envelope combinations and envelope slopes/CIs. For branch assessment form each case's full asymmetric log-residual interval; departure requires its whole interval to lie beyond +/-ln(1.25), and robust branch falsification requires the same matched S_eta departure at both grids. Compare refinement only on identical matched S_eta points; persistence requires conservative Delta-p interval wholly inside +/-0.10. Disagreement is unresolved numerical sensitivity, not a physical falsifier. A band violation is decisive only when matched base and refined conservative intervals are both disjoint from [-0.60,-0.40] on the same side; overlap never rejects. Missing paths/windows and failed numerical, pre-plasmoid or resolution screens are explicit ineligibility/censoring. Finite samples do not establish a continuous-domain or universal claim. Physical falsification is blocked whenever matched spatial refinement is not meaningful; incompatible base/refined slopes are classified as unresolved numerical sensitivity before testing band or branch falsification.
planned_execution_policy: No decisive run until production method approval. Given the current remaining budget, prioritize low and high base endpoints, then the remaining distinct-resistivity base points if affordable; hold matched 1.25x refinement. If matched refinement cannot be run, persistence stays unresolved.
